basic_info.description: Perched on a tree-lined street in Cole Valley, just blocks from Buena Vista Park and Cole Valley's shops and dining, this top-floor 2-bedroom, 1.5bath condo crowns a classic 2-unit building and features abundant natural light, timeless details & SF views. The spacious living room is filled w. west-facing light, with large windows framing sunset views of Mt. Sutro & the GG Bridge spires. A fireplace & built-in shelving add warmth & character. Just off the living room, a formal dining room connects seamlessly to the kitchen, making entertaining effortless. An office w/ a built-in desk across from the dining room offers flexibility for a functional workspace. The renovated kitchen has Wolf & SubZero appliances, quartz countertops & a charming breakfast area. Just off the kitchen, a pantry houses the W/D and additional storage. Both bedrooms are tucked at the rear of the home, offering quiet privacy, with lush garden views. The full bathroom & powder room have been remodeled. Additional highlights include two-car deeded parking, a shared yard & a deeded storage room in the shared garage. Structural upgrades. A central yet peaceful location offers easy access to GG Park, Twin Peaks & Tank Hill perfect for hiking & bikingplus everyday favorites in nearby Cole Valley. 90 Walk Score.
